name: Vilyvitány (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and blue at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Vilyvitány: a red and blue shield with the letters V and V, a patriarchal cross and a green mound, above a yellow scroll inscribed VILYVITÁNY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
